what: nhà khách Hạ Long (khách sạn Hạ Long), the guest house at 102 Hạ Long on the side of the hill
uses: Plan 0026, R7, Q7: on its OSM outline (way 235149416), about 300 m south of Hải Âu (out of the area of D1; seen from the jetty and the walk).

photos.author: trungydang
photos.shows: Hạ Long to the north near Cầu Đá: a cream block of many storeys on the right (Nhà khách Hạ Long), shops, blue lamp poles with a curved frame, the silver domes of the terminal of the jetty, a round white building on the sea side, green lamp posts with four white globes on the walk.

photos.author: Venanzio_KH (Flickr)
photos.shows: Behind the sea wall and the road: a white block with the blue letters HA LONG HOTEL on its roof, seven rows of windows over the trees, a machine room on the roof.

checks: Views: front, three quarters, far (from the jetty).
A white block of eight storeys with a machine room on its roof and the blue letters HA LONG HOTEL on the roof edge.
